t: The LAP IP66 13A 1G switched weatherproof outdoor socket provides a durable and reliable power solution for external electrical installations. Constructed from robust polycarbonate, it offers IK00 impact resistance and is IP66 rated, ensuring dust-tight and waterproof protection in all weather conditions. Ideal for garden power tools, outdoor lighting, or workshop applications, this unit features a semi-transparent cover and an LED neon indicator for quick visual power status checks. A lockable lid enhances safety, while backed-out captive terminal screws and side and rear knockouts simplify secure wiring and installation, delivering long-lasting performance.
b: IP66 rated – dust-tight and waterproof in use
